build.buildCommand: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && REQ_FILE=requirements.txt; [ -f "$REQ_FILE" ] || REQ_FILE=flask-react-supabase-app/backend/requirements.txt; python -m pip install -r "$REQ_FILE" && OCR_SCRIPT=download_ocr_models.py; [ -f "$OCR_SCRIPT" ] || OCR_SCRIPT=flask-react-supabase-app/backend/download_ocr_models.py; mkdir -p /app/easyocr_models && EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR=/app/easyocr_models python "$OCR_SCRIPT"

deploy.startCommand: export PATH="$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH"; export EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR="${EASYOCR_MODEL_DIR:-/app/easyocr_models}"; export TESSERACT_CMD="${TESSERACT_CMD:-/usr/bin/tesseract}"; if [ "${SERVICE_ROLE:-web}" = "worker" ]; then if [ -f worker.py ]; then exec python worker.py; elif [ -f flask-react-supabase-app/backend/worker.py ]; then cd flask-react-supabase-app/backend && exec python worker.py; else echo 'worker.py not found' && exit 1; fi; else if [ -f app.py ]; then exec gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py app:app; elif [ -f flask-react-supabase-app/backend/app.py ]; then cd flask-react-supabase-app/backend && exec gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py app:app; else echo 'app.py not found' && exit 1; fi; fi
